THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 07.04.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 2025:KER:30203 WP(C) NO. 6892 OF 2025  3  T.R. RAVI, J.
 --------------------------------------------
 W.P.(C) No.6892 of 2025  --------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 07th day of April, 2025  JUDGMENT
The prayer of the petitioners is that the respondents should be directed to acquire the remaining portion which has been left out after acquisition since it cannot be put to any use.

The issue regarding the applicability of Section 94 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 in acquisitions relating to National Highways was considered by this Court in a batch of writ petitions in W.P.(C) No.5944/2021 and connected cases.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The judgment of this Court was taken up in appeal by the National Highway Authorities and the Division Bench has also now disposed of the appeals, affirming the judgment in the writ petitions.

Since the issue is already covered by the judgments of 2025:KER:30203 WP(C) NO. 6892 OF 2025 this Court, this writ petition is disposed of, directing the 3 rd respondent to consider and pass orders on Ext.P4 in terms of the judgment of the learned Single Judge in W.P.(C) No.5944/2021 and connected cases and the judgment of the Division Bench in W.A.No.718 of 2024 and connected cases.
Necessary orders shall be issued within two months from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
